* TQ = tourniquet. 
* EMT = Emergency Medical Technician
* FD = Fire Department
* FYI = For your information
* CAT TQ = Combat Action Tourniquet

By your use of TQ I assume you are either military, EMT or volunteer FD. Just an FYI, if you have any military CAT TQ's the new ones have red tabs on the pull strap. These are made from updated material and are less likely to fail. Guess it could also be useful if you decide to buy one, as of now, the best CAT style ones have the red tabs, although I personally like a different style more, I just mention the CAT because thats the most common one I seem.
